title: Anyone wanna join up in a discord?
author: rags2riches100
selftext: I have been using AI to screen for options trades and to analyze market structure, sentiment and trends. I see people are using AI is a lot of different ways but it would be cool to come  together as a little community and share ideas and experiences. Nothing serious but def would like to connect with some likeminded individuals!

comments.body: I have one I'm building for my trading site clockoutcapital.com but it's not finished and I'm waiting on legal to approve all the legal docs so it won't be live until August, but that is one of the purpose of the discord. Since my site is built for agents and bots and comes with extensive TA built in,  there is a dedicated trade talk room.  Shoot me a dm if your interested and send an invite when it's ready.
